findings.claim_text: It finds multi-agent systems gain up to 80.8% on decomposable financial reasoning but lose 39% to 70% on sequential planning, and that coordination returns shrink or turn negative once a single agent already scores above about 45%.
The vendor products tell a different story, because every one that documents its architecture has a coordinator.
findings.contradicting_quote: a scalable self-organized multi-agent harness without a central orchestrator

findings.claim_text: Jellyfish telemetry across 12,000 developers in the first quarter put the median at about 51 million tokens, about $52 a month at published Claude API prices.
findings.contradicting_quote: Median $213 per engineer per week (roughly $920 per month), four weeks ending August 2, 2026
